subject: Zoning Ordinance Cleanup Amendments
overview: The Medford Community Development Board reviewed draft amendments to standardize and clean up the city's zoning ordinance. The board also discussed future zoning priorities and voted to advise the City Council to take up Tufts institutional zoning next.

items.title: Discussion of Zoning Cleanup Draft Amendment
items.summary: Board members and planning staff reviewed draft zoning cleanup amendments addressing formatting, table captions, citywide building height definitions, and consolidated developer incentive tables.

items.title: Zoning Schedule and Administrative Updates
items.summary: The board voted to advise the City Council to prioritize Tufts institutional zoning as its next study area and reviewed upcoming development filings and department updates.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the draft meeting minutes for September 16, 2026, and October 7, 2026.
